Uniform.Title: Uniforms
Uniform.Name: Name
Uniform.Add: Add a color to choose from

enabled.Name: Show 3D mechs
enabled.Hint: Mech tokens show their 3D mech instead of their image, on this computer.

quality.Name: Quality
quality.Hint: How sharp mechs are, and how often a second they move. Lower is easier on a slow computer.

motion.Name: Motion
motion.Hint: When mechs move: never, only while they walk or act, or always, standing too.

actions.Name: Act along with LANCER
actions.Hint: Mechs attack, use systems and react when they are hit.

turnLocked.Name: Turn tokens with locked rotation
turnLocked.Hint: LANCER locks the rotation of new actors to keep portraits upright. A mech still faces where its token does.

walkPace.Name: Walk animation speed
walkPace.Hint: How fast mechs step for the ground they cover. 1 is exactly as their feet need; lower is fewer, longer steps, which looks better although the feet slide a little.

speed.Name: Speed of mechs
speed.Hint: How many spaces per second the token of a mech moves. Foundry moves tokens at 6.

Location.Label: Location
Location.Hint: Its name is the same on every frame, so that mechs of one unit have the same insignia at the same place. A mech has each location once.
Location.PlaceHint: Shift+click the mech to put the location there, or hold Shift and drag it over the surface. It shows its name here.
Location.TurnHint: Turns what is on it clockwise, in degrees
